snippet.title: Guns & Goo - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Finnish Studio Meteor Works announces Guns & Goo!

A frantic 2D multiplayer shooter where fully destructible levels and constantly changing rules turn every battle into an unpredictable, laugh-out-loud showdown.
